segments.vo: Nvidia's CEO just resigned, and an AI company is heading for a trillion-dollar IPO. Here's your tech news in 60 seconds.

Number one. Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia's CEO, days after admitting an affair with a woman US officials reportedly tied to Chinese intelligence. Nothing is proven, and Nvidia says it has no reason to believe secrets leaked. CFO Colette Kress steps in as interim CEO.
Number two. Anthropic, the company behind Claude, plans to list on Nasdaq next week, at a value of about 1.2 trillion dollars.
Number three. SpaceX will spend over 74 billion dollars on giant AI supercomputer campuses in Texas and Arizona.
Number four. Nonprofit groups are suing OpenAI, Google, Meta, Anthropic and SpaceX, asking a court to freeze next-gen AI until it's proven safe.
And number five. Google and Samsung's Gemini smart glasses are on pre-order from 395 dollars, shipping December 10th.
Which story shocked you most? Comment below, and follow TechVibe24 for more.
